component.name: TVGuide

Label.text: Choose a channel to start its shuffled playlist

component.script:
sub init() m.channelGrid = m.top.findNode("channelGrid") m.top.observeField("content", "onContentChanged") m.channelGrid.observeField("itemSelected", "onItemSelected") end sub
sub onContentChanged() m.channelGrid.content = m.top.content end sub
sub onItemSelected(event as object) position = event.getData() if type(position) = "roArray" m.top.channelSelected = position[0] * m.channelGrid.numColumns + position[1] else m.top.channelSelected = position end if end sub
sub focusGuide() m.channelGrid.setFocus(true) end sub
